title: Cartwise Gift Cards Terms: Value Life, Bonus Value and Fees
content:
Purchased value on every Cartwise Gift Cards card type never expires, and no card type charges a monthly inactivity fee. Promotional bonus value exists on one card type only, the Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card, and it is the only card type whose value can expire.

## Terms by card type

| Card type | Card value can expire | Purchased value expires | Monthly inactivity fee | Bonus value loaded per 50.00 of purchased value | Bonus period after activation | Which value is spent first |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | No | No | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | 0 days (no bonus) | Purchased value only |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | No | No | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | 0 days (no bonus) | Purchased value only |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | No | No | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | 0 days (no bonus) | Purchased value only |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | Yes | No | 0.00 | 10.00 | 90 calendar days | Bonus value first |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | No | No | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | 0 days (no bonus) | Purchased value only |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | No | No | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | 0 days (no bonus) | Purchased value only |

Amounts are in US dollars.

## Terms explained

1. **Purchased value.** The value paid for a card, and any value reloaded onto it, does not expire on any card type.
2. **Inactivity fee.** The monthly inactivity fee is 0.00 on every card type; a card that goes unused loses nothing through fees.
3. **Bonus value.** A Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card carries promotional bonus value of 10.00 for each full 50.00 of purchased value. No other card type carries bonus value; a bonus period of 0 days marks a type with no bonus.
4. **Bonus period.** Bonus value on a Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card is limited to a bonus period of 90 calendar days counted from activation, after which unused bonus value expires.
5. **Order of spending.** Where a card holds both bonus value and purchased value, the Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card spends bonus value first. Every other card type holds purchased value only.
6. **Expiring value.** "Card value can expire" is Yes only for the Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card, and on that card the purchased part still never expires.

## Questions answered by these terms

**Does a Cartwise Corporate Gift Card lose value if it sits unused for a year?**
No. Its value does not expire and its monthly inactivity fee is 0.00.

**On a Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card holding both kinds of value, which is used on the next order?**
Bonus value, because that card type spends bonus value first.
